statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled 2026-09-16 decision. Reference: target range 3.50 to 3.75 percent on the packet date 2026-09-04.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC policy statement on federalreserve.gov for the 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-16 meeting sets a target range with upper bound above 3.75 percent. Adjudicated 2026-09-18.
failure_condition: The FOMC statement issued 2026-09-16 leaves the upper bound of the target range at or below 3.75 percent.

statement: FRED series DGS10 prints at or above 5.00 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 4.78 percent on the packet date 2026-09-04.
resolution: TRUE if any daily observation of FRED series DGS10 dated between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-30 equals or exceeds 5.00. Adjudicated 2026-12-03.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 daily observation dated 2026-09-08 through 2026-11-30 is below 5.00.

statement: Front-month NYMEX WTI settles at or above 100.00 dollars on at least one trading day between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 90.35 on the packet date 2026-09-04.
resolution: TRUE if CME publishes a front-month WTI crude settlement of 100.00 or higher for any trade date between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-30. Adjudicated 2026-12-03.
failure_condition: No front-month WTI settlement dated 2026-09-08 through 2026-11-30 reaches 100.00.

statement: The South Korean government announces a naval or military deployment to Strait of Hormuz escort or security operations between 2026-09-07 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if the defence ministry or presidential office of South Korea announces such a deployment in that window and both Yonhap and Reuters report it. Adjudicated 2026-12-18.
failure_condition: No South Korean government announcement of a Hormuz naval or military deployment falls inside the window.

statement: Russia and Ukraine sign a written ceasefire or cessation-of-hostilities agreement covering the main front line between 2026-09-05 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if authorized representatives of both states sign such a document in that window and Reuters and TASS both report the signing. Adjudicated 2027-01-05.
failure_condition: No bilateral Russia-Ukraine ceasefire or cessation-of-hostilities document is signed on or before 2026-12-31.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog gains an entry for a Google Chromium V8 vulnerability with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities JSON contains a Google Chromium V8 record whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-09. Adjudicated 2026-10-13.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog holds no Chromium V8 record with a dateAdded between 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-09.

statement: A CVE for the Cisco Nexus 9000 unauthenticated remote code execution flaw enters the CISA KEV catalog with dateAdded between 2026-09-04 and 2027-02-15.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON lists a Cisco NX-OS or Nexus 9000 record matching that flaw with dateAdded between 2026-09-04 and 2027-02-15. Adjudicated 2027-02-18.
failure_condition: No Cisco Nexus 9000 or NX-OS record matching this flaw carries a KEV dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The AfD is allocated more than half of all Landtag seats in the Saxony-Anhalt state election held 2026-09-06.
resolution: TRUE if the preliminary official result from the Landeswahlleiter of Saxony-Anhalt assigns the AfD more than half the seats in the new Landtag. Adjudicated 2026-09-11.
failure_condition: The preliminary official seat allocation gives the AfD half or fewer of the Landtag seats.

statement: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte is taken into physical custody or surrenders to a Philippine court between 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if Philippine authorities book or process her in custody, or she surrenders in court, in that window, per Reuters and the Philippine Daily Inquirer. Adjudicated 2026-11-03.
failure_condition: She is neither booked into custody nor surrendered to a court on or before 2026-10-30.

statement: USGS catalogs an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 300 km of event us7000tdvt with origin time between 2026-09-05 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query returns an M6.0 or greater event within 300 km of the us7000tdvt epicenter with origin time in that window. Adjudicated 2026-10-19.
failure_condition: No USGS-catalogued M6.0 or greater event occurs within 300 km of us7000tdvt inside the window.
